SESHA-P6V16B-navakunda.game: Nine-kunda expiation homa program (center Virabhadra -> distribute -> svishtakrit -> kalasha-abhisheka); maintenance-loop rite.

SESHA-P6V19B-homadravya.claim_en: Expiation-homa dravyas: udumbara sticks, ghee, honey a thousand and a hundred; tila with vasu, sarshapa, mudga, shali; dadhi, makshika, ghrita a hundred in order; close with kalasha-abhisheka and puja. For portents kindle Ishana square-kunda shanti-homa; Surya/Vaishravana/Vag-Uma/Shiva-prakriti prayaschitta-homas south of the house in bow-shaped half-moon kundas, the guru offering alone.
SESHA-P6V19B-homadravya.claim_sa: उदुम्बर ... घृतहविः सहस्रं शतं ... तिला वसुयुतं ससर्षपसमुद्गशालीयवाः ... शतं च दधि माक्षिकं घृतमपीह ... होमान्ते कलशेनाभिषिच्य देवं प्रपूजयेत् ... ईशकोणे ... शान्तिहोमं ... गेहदक्षिणदिशि ... अर्धचन्द्राभे कुण्डे ... ।। १९-२० ।।

source.note: OCR layer; verses 19-20 combined; upgrade after edition cross-check

SESHA-P6V19B-homadravya.game: Expiation-homa dravya/count table + kunda geometries (square-Ishana, halfmoon-south); maintenance-rite inventory content.

SESHA-P6V31B-chaitanya.claim_en: Homam in creation order with all tattva-mantras and ghee as able, separately; offering vata-samidha-adi dravyas with mula, complete the homa well; offer sampata, draw out the fire-dwelling consciousness into the kumbha, contemplating it with japa as the whole-self dawn; then bathe (snapana) with that kalasha water per pitha-arcana rule, and worship with nyasa first.
SESHA-P6V31B-chaitanya.claim_sa: ... स्वाखिलतत्त्वमन्त्रैराज्यं ... पृथग् जुहोतु ... मूलेन ... होमं सुसमापयेत् ... सम्पातं ... वह्निगतचैतन्यं समुद्‌धृत्य तत् कुम्भे ... प्रतिजप्य ... ... स्नपयेत् ... तन्न्यासपूर्वं यजेत् ... ।। ३१-३३ ।।

source.note: OCR layer; verses 31-33 combined; upgrade after edition cross-check

SESHA-P6V31B-chaitanya.game: Chaitanya-transfer program (fire -> kumbha -> snapana -> nyasa); prana-pratishtha-adjacent quest content.

SESHA-P6V60B-kalaavadhi.claim_en: The remembered time-limit (kala-avadhi) runs from a month up to twelve years; beyond a month no distress-dwelling is permitted by the Supreme; let all gods worshipped in this prasada hear it.
SESHA-P6V60B-kalaavadhi.claim_sa: मासादूर्ध्वं द्वादशाब्दादर्वाक् कालावधिः स्मृतः ।। ६० ।। ... नावग् ... क्लेशवासं परमेष्ठ्यनुमन्यते । श्रृण्वन्तु देवताः सर्वाः प्रासादमिममर्चिताः ।

source.note: OCR layer; upgrade after edition cross-check

SESHA-P6V60B-kalaavadhi.game: Maintenance clock (1 month soft limit, 12-year hard cycle); jirnoddharana scheduler span data.

SESHA-P6V70B-nishkramana.claim_en: Prepare the jiva-kalasha: fill an iron kumbha per rite, perform the murti-anchored avahana rite, pray to the god, offer the sampata pair into the mantra-image, then begin the going-forth (nishkramana) procession; at closure, recall the jiva from the image with conch (dara) sound.
SESHA-P6V70B-nishkramana.claim_sa: ... लौहं कुम्भं विधिवत् सम्पूर्य मूर्तिध्यावाहननिष्ठं कर्म कृत्वाथ निष्क्रामणमारभेत ... सम्पातयुग्मं ... ।। ७० ।। ... दरेण शङ्खेनातो बिम्बाज्जीवमावाहयेत् ... ।। ७२ ।।

source.note: OCR layer; verses 70-72 combined; upgrade after edition cross-check

SESHA-P6V70B-nishkramana.game: Going-forth program (jiva-kalasha -> procession) + closure recall (conch); festival open/close beats.

TS-P1V04B-yajamana.claim_en: The patron (yajamana) undertaking image-installation for daily worship shall be devoted to the duties prescribed for his varna and ashrama, possessed of wealth earned by proper means, and shall first of all choose (varana) an excellent preceptor (guruvara).
TS-P1V04B-yajamana.claim_sa: वर्णाश्रमाधिकृतकर्मरत ... तदुक्तन्यायात्तवित्तनिचयः ... प्रतिमाप्रतिष्ठा- कर्मोन्मना गुरुवरं प्रथमं वृणीत ।। 4 ।।
TS-P1V04B-yajamana.game: Role gates: yajamana eligibility (duties + honest wealth); guru-varana is the mandatory first quest step before any construction rite.

TS-P1V27B-preceptor.claim_en: Whoever wishes to institute a ritual performance shall select an expert preceptor along with his attendants, to perform the rite in proper order right from plot selection up to the final holy bath.
TS-P1V27B-preceptor.game: Campaign frame: preceptor+attendants party selected first; quest arc runs plot->build->consecration->bath (mirrors temple_plot phases).

TS-P1V30B-bhumi.claim_en: Best (shreshtha) ground: cattle and people, fruit/flower/milk trees, level, eastward-sloping with pradakshina water, firm, deep-sounding, quick seed germination, dust-surplus on pit-fill test, perennial water, temperate in cold and heat. Opposite traits = worst (adhama); mixed = middle (madhyama).
TS-P1V30B-bhumi.claim_sa: ... फलपुष्पदुग्धतरुभिः ... समा ... प्राक्प्लवा ... स्निग्धा ... धीररवा ... आशुबीजोद्गमा ... बहुपांसुः ... अक्षयजला ... शीतोष्णयोस्तुल्या ... श्रेष्ठा ... समुक्तविपरीता अधमा ... मिश्रिता मध्यमा ।। 30 ।।
TS-P1V30B-bhumi.game: Site survey: bhumi graded shreshtha/madhyama/adhama by marks + field tests; adhama rejected (fail-closed); survey is the first yajamana quest step after guru-varana.

TS-P1V31B-bhumivarjya.claim_en: Avoid for deity installation any plot shaped like a winnowing fan, half-moon, trident, fish, boar-back or tawny-cow face; containing ashes, charcoal, grain chaff, bones, hair, worms or termite hills; with depressed middle, central cavity, foul smell or prominent corners.
TS-P1V31B-bhumivarjya.game: Site survey fail-closed reject list: shape/content/feature flags; any hit rejects the plot (links to Tantra-prayaschitta impurity causes).

TS-P1V33B-soiltest.claim_en: Mixed-type ground (mixed colour, smell and taste) is unacceptable for all castes alike.
TS-P1V33B-soiltest.game: Site survey soil assay (colour/smell/taste); mixed result rejects plot for every patron class.

TS-P1V35B-ksheeradhara.claim_en: The preceptor shall sprinkle the milk of a red cow to the chant of the respective mula mantras one hundred times (site purification).
TS-P1V35B-ksheeradhara.game: Site-shuddhi rite (100x milk sprinkling); consumes milk inventory; precedes sutra-line marking (V89B).

TS-P1V38B-wickdivine.claim_en: The mantra-proficient preceptor lights wicks with hymns, worships the intended deity (or Surya); after covering the four burning wicks awhile, the wick of the patron's caste flaring up marks the ground suitable.
TS-P1V38B-wickdivine.game: Site-divination mini-rite (wick flare = suitability omen); survey quest resolution mechanic.

TS-P1V39B-supadma.claim_en: Supadma land - most suited for installing gods and solace-giving - grows camphor, agaru, coconut, tilaka, darbha, kadamba, arjuna, sandal, arecanut, sugarcane, ketaka, kusha, kunda, lotus and blue lotus in abundance, with water flowing east as well as north and plenty (perennial) of it.
TS-P1V39B-supadma.game: Premium site grade (vegetation + dual-direction water); kavu/vegetation and water-system placement cite this.

TS-P1V41B-purna.claim_en: Purna (full) land - extremely suitable for a god-house, nourishing wealth and grain - bears plaksha, nyagrodha, nimba, arjuna, bakula, kulastha, asana, ashoka, nishpava, ankola, malati, champaka, tila, khadira and kodrava, and lies on a hilltop or mountain slope with scant water.
TS-P1V41B-purna.game: Site grade (hill/slope + marker flora + scant water); terrain generator biome input for hilltop ksetras.

TS-P1V42B-dhumra.claim_en: Dhumra (smoky) land - harmful and sorrow-giving to the yajamana - bears arka, bamboo, vibhitaka, snuhi, shlesmataka and pilu; is pebbly, hard, cavitied, barren (ushara), and frequented by vulture, falcon, hog, crow, jackal and monkeys.
TS-P1V42B-dhumra.game: Site hard-reject (dhumra marks + scavenger fauna); survey fail state with sorrow consequence hook.

TS-P1V46B-vacatemantra.claim_en: Recite the prayer-mantra: spirits or demons, whoever occupy the place, let them all go away from the place being made an abode of Hari - substituting, for Hari's station, the name of the deity for whose installation the land is taken.
TS-P1V46B-vacatemantra.claim_sa: प्रार्थनामन्त्रं पठति भूतानीति ।। 46 ।। ... यद्यदर्थमिह गृह्यते मही तत्पदं हरिपदेऽत्र योजयेत् ।
TS-P1V46B-vacatemantra.game: Site-clearing utterance (deity-name parameterized); vastubali pre-rite before sutra-lines (V89B).

TS-P1V53B-clearlevel.claim_en: Thereafter clear and level the ground and its regions, then measure them out with appropriate designs (before the ploughing rite).
TS-P1V53B-clearlevel.game: Site-prep step (clear -> level -> measure); precedes ploughing (V55B) and sutra-lines (V89B).

TS-P1V55B-plough.claim_en: Purified with mantras, the preceptor shall on an auspicious day and time plough the land with two bulls of equal height yoked to an asana-wood plough-head.
TS-P1V55B-plough.game: Site-prep rite (ploughing with yoked pair); bovines + plough props; calendar-gated.

TS-P1V59B-foundationpit.claim_en: Dig the foundation pit to a man's height, or till water or rock is met; on an auspicious day fill up three-fourths of the pit.
TS-P1V59B-foundationpit.game: Foundation step (dig to man/water/rock, fill 3/4); shilanyasa quest chain hook.

TS-P1V60B-vastumandala.claim_en: Lay the vastumandala: ten sutra lines lengthwise and breadthwise making nine chambers; center nine padas as svastika or eight-petalled lotus; outer ring six padas on cardinals, paired padas on corners (agni/vayu E-W, others N-S); strew darbha per pada; worship the pitha, then Vastupurusha first with 'Om vam vastupurushaya namah' and vamadi anga-mantras.
TS-P1V60B-vastumandala.game: Site-mandala grid procedure (9-puta + center + outer ring + darbha + pitha + mantra); survey-stage mandala mini-game data.

TS-P1V64B-avahanakrama.claim_en: Invoke the twelve mandala mantras in order from the east up to Ishana (northeast); for outer-side invocation, invoke the corner-pair lords changing (reversing) the sequence; use -anta mantra forms.
TS-P1V64B-avahanakrama.game: Mandala-avahana order program (inner east->Isana, outer corner-pairs reversed); survey-stage invocation mini-rite.

TS-P1V65B-devata32full.claim_en: The thirty-two outer-ring mandala deities in pradakshina order from Ishana: Ishana, Parjanya, Jayanta, Indra, Surya, Satyaka, Bhrisha, Antariksha, Vahni, Pusha, Vitatha, Grihakshata, Yama, Gandharva, Bhringaraja, Mriga, Pitrs, Dauvarika, Sugriva, Pushpadanta, Varuna, Asura, Shosha, Roga, Vayu, Naga, Mukhya, Bhallataka, Soma, Argalaka, Diti, Uditi.
TS-P1V65B-devata32full.game: Full 32-station mandala roster (ordered); survey mini-rite invocation data; replaces queued subset.

TS-P1V67B-devata32.claim_en: Thirty-two deities stand outside, one per pada from Ishana corner in pradakshina order, beginning Mukhya, Bhallataka, Soma, Argalaka, Diti, Uditi (full roster across verses 65-67; complete 32-name curation queued).
TS-P1V67B-devata32.game: Mandala outer-ring roster (32 stations); invocation-order data for the survey mini-rite (full names queued).

TS-P1V68B-mandalakrama.claim_en: Archana order: for Hari (Vishnu) and Mahisha-nihantr (Durga) worship inner and outer circles alike; for the other five, first the thirty-two outer-ring deities from Ishana, then the twelve inner ones from Apavatsa to Mahidhara, ending with Brahma at the center.
TS-P1V68B-mandalakrama.game: Master mandala-archana order (deity-class switch); survey mini-rite controller logic.

TS-P1V70B-outerring.claim_en: Outside the 32-ring: Sharva, Skanda, Aryama, Jambhaka, Pinchaka on the cardinals; Charaki, Vidari, Putanika, Paparaksasi on the corners; devas, asuras, gandharvas, yakshas, pitris, nagas, rakshasas, pishachas and grahas in the eight directions from the east, invoked as deva-grahebhyo namah and the like.
TS-P1V70B-outerring.game: Outermost mandala ring roster (cardinals/corners/8-dir); completes the 3-ring mandala data (32 + 12 + outer + Brahma).

TS-P1V71B-balifood.claim_en: Thereafter propitiate all fifty-three (mandala deities) offering bali with a part of the prepared food; the deities outside these receive one round each with five-substance oblations (turmeric, parched/fried rice and the like).
TS-P1V71B-balifood.game: Bali program (53 food-bali + outer panchadravya rounds); sreebhoothabali/utsava-bali scheduler content.

TS-P1V73B-vasturaksha.claim_en: Having offered bali with repeated water rounds and propitiated central Brahma with prasanna-puja, meditate the mid-prakara ground upheld by the host of vastu deities (who are never dismissed - no udvasana) and perform the raksha (protection) rite against obstacles.
TS-P1V73B-vasturaksha.game: Vastu-raksha program (bali -> prasanna -> raksha); site protection buff rite; vastu-devatas persistent (no udvasana).

TS-P1V74B-nidhipot.claim_en: In the cleared pit set a valuables pot (nidhi-kumbha) upon a slab, sprinkling seeds and corn over it.
TS-P1V74B-nidhipot.game: Foundation-deposit step (nidhi pot + seed sprinkling); shilanyasa quest chain hook.

TS-P1V77B-kurmashila.claim_en: Direct the tortoise-shaped stone (kurma-shila) toward the planned shrine opening, establish and worship it ritually with the prayer to Vishnu the tortoise-formed world-bearer (namaste kurmarupaya vishnave vishvadharine).
TS-P1V77B-kurmashila.game: Foundation deposit: oriented kurma-shila + Vishnu-Kurma prayer; shilanyasa quest content.

TS-P1V79B-silverlotus.claim_en: Over the tortoise stone set a silver lotus (itself tortoise-shaped) with the earlier mantra.
TS-P1V79B-silverlotus.game: Deposit layering (kurma -> silver lotus); shilanyasa quest content.

TS-P1V81B-bricks.claim_en: Set eight bricks (ashteshtaka) in the (eight) directions with a kalasha upon the prepared pitha; bricks purified, dried and worshipped with their mantras (other deities after dravyahorna).
TS-P1V81B-bricks.game: First-brick program (8 directional bricks + kalasha); shilanyasa quest content.

TS-P2V04B-yoni8.claim_en: The eight yonis from the east in order are Dhvaja, Dhuma, Simha, Kukkura, Vrisha, Khara, Gaja, Vayasa; the odd ones (Dhvaja, Simha, Vrisha, Gaja) bring prosperity, the even ones (Dhuma, Kukkura, Khara, Vayasa) misfortune. Fractional (non-integral) yoni results are not to be adopted; only whole yonis count.
TS-P2V04B-yoni8.claim_sa: प्रागादियोनयोऽष्टौ ... ध्वजधूमसिंहकुक्कुरवृषखरगजवायसाः ... तेष्वयुजः सम्पदे युजो विपदे ।। 4 ।।
TS-P2V04B-yoni8.game: Site/orientation field: 8-yoni compass with odd-shubha selection; fractional paridhi results rejected (fail-closed); mandapa nodes take directional yonis under this rule.

TS-P2V05B-ayavyaya.claim_en: Income (aya) must exceed expenditure (vyaya) in every way; otherwise (excess expenditure) brings ruin. Asterism/tithi auspiciousness is to be known from jyotisha in the usual way.
TS-P2V05B-ayavyaya.claim_sa: आयाधिक्यं व्ययतः सम्पाद्यं सर्वथान्यथापत्तिः । नक्षत्रादिशुभत्वं ज्योतिः शास्त्रादिभिः सुविज्ञेयम् ।। 5 ।।
TS-P2V05B-ayavyaya.game: Economy invariant: temple/rite ledgers must keep aya > vyaya (offering economy + maintenance budgets); calendar picks route to jyotisha data, never invented.

TS-P2V101B-bimbahand.claim_en: The middle distance between thumb and index finger is two angulas (hand-span datum of the tala series continuing through feet measures V101-106).
TS-P2V101B-bimbahand.game: Murti-hand datum (2-angula gap); deity-figure generator input.

TS-P2V103B-bimbashank.claim_en: The two shanks measure six angulas at the base, seven at the middle, and three angulas plus three yavas at the end.
TS-P2V103B-bimbashank.game: Murti-shank taper table; deity-figure generator input.

TS-P2V108B-limbshape.claim_en: Shape the limbs - shanks, thighs, hands, mid-chest and fingers - as rounded (circular in section), emulating an elephant's trunk.
TS-P2V108B-limbshape.game: Murti-limb section rule (round); deity-figure generator input.

TS-P2V109B-diadem.claim_en: All deities bear a well-decorated head diadem eight angulas high, with three, five or seven crowns, shaped like an egg, lotus, umbrella or tortoise.
TS-P2V109B-diadem.game: Murti-crown selector (count + shape); deity-figure generator input.

TS-P2V10B-stambha.claim_en: Shape the wooden pillar so the base-to-beam measure divided by eight, nine or ten is less than the base circumference (slender top, larger base); a brick wall-pillar instead carries a wider top (danda), tapering by one-fourth to three-fourths of the circumference.
TS-P2V10B-stambha.game: Builder params: mandapa pillar taper (1 - 1/d), brick pilasters flare to danda; applies to Mukha/Namaskara/Koothambalam pillars.

TS-P2V115B-ganapati.claim_en: Vighnesha (three-eyed, elephant-faced, slightly bent neck, huge body, seated or standing) is shaped in five talas: one tala face below the diadem, two and a half talas face-to-hip, one and a half talas hips-legs-hands.
TS-P2V115B-ganapati.game: Ganapati figure canon (5-tala, seated/standing); joins Vishnu/Durga canons in the deity-figure roster.

TS-P2V117B-padmapitha.claim_en: The lotus seat (padma-pitha), one to two talas high: divide height by six - first share the base slab, two shares an eight-petalled lotus; at the center a three-fourth-tala double petal layer; above, three talas of eight-petalled lotus; seat height includes the base petals.
TS-P2V117B-padmapitha.game: Pitha lotus-seat program (slab + 8-petal + center + upper lotus); pitha node builder params.

TS-P2V118B-nala.claim_en: At the lotus-seat base set a tubular nala stem, square-topped, twenty, twentyone or twentytwo pratima-angulas broad with the top reduced by one-eighth, one-seventh or one-sixth, long enough to hold the idol; the nala is Brahma-ruled for all deities, but round-shaped it is Shiva-ruled (Rudra-devata).
TS-P2V118B-nala.claim_sa: ... विंशत्या वा सैकया विंशत्या वा सद्विकया विंशत्या वा ... प्रतिमाङ्गुलैः ... नालमारचयतु ... अष्टांशेन वा सप्तांशेन वा षडंशेन वा हीन ... नपुंसकशिलापर्यन्त ... ... वृत्तं शिवात्मकं ... ।। 118 ।।
TS-P2V118B-nala.game: Pitha-drain param: round Shaiva nala, 21 pratima-angulas, top reduced 1/7; builder renders stem + pranala outlet on north.

TS-P2V119B-linga14.claim_en: Lingas for the four varnas are fourteen in all - five for Brahmins, three each for Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras - with lengths stepping down by a quarter hasta (Brahmin set around five down to four hastas; Kshatriya around three and three-quarter down; Vaishya three down to two and a half; Shudra two and a half down to one and three-quarter); further anuloma/pratiloma sets step by quarter hastas from two karas downward.
TS-P2V119B-linga14.claim_sa: लिङ्गानि ... पञ्चहस्तादि ... ह्रासादेकैकपादतः । लिङ्गं पञ्चविधं ... अन्येषां च त्रयं त्रयम् ।। 119 ।। (full in passage anchor)
TS-P2V119B-linga14.game: Deity-form param: linga length selector by varna set; slice uses 4-hasta linga (Brahmin set); tripartite caturasra/astasra/vritta shaping per TS Shivalinga-lakshana (to be curated next).

TS-P2V121B-bimbaheight.claim_en: To fix the idol height, divide the sanctum (garbha) circumference by five, nine or two, and take the resultant measure as the idol height.
TS-P2V121B-bimbaheight.game: Idol-height selector (garbha/5|9|2); cross-checks the 4-hasta slice linga against garbha 4h (paridhi ~16h -> /4? recorded check).

TS-P2V122B-tripartite.claim_en: Divide the idol's total length equally into three: the base part square (caturasra, Brahma), the middle eight-cornered (astasra, Vishnu), the top circular (vritta, Rudra).
TS-P2V122B-tripartite.game: Linga/bimba tripartite constructor (equal thirds square/octagonal/round); builder linga already follows this.

TS-P2V123B-bimbawidth.claim_en: For the idol width: divide the fixed height by twenty-four and take eight of the resultant measures (one-third of the height).
TS-P2V123B-bimbawidth.game: Idol-width rule (1/3 height); deity-figure generator input.

TS-P2V124B-shilathirds.claim_en: Divide the selected idol stone into three: shape the base third square (caturasra, Brahma part), then sixteen- and thirty-two-angled transitions rising toward the round (vritta) top.
TS-P2V124B-shilathirds.game: Stone-cutting program with 16/32-angle transition courses; refines the tripartite constructor.

TS-P2V126B-lingatop.claim_en: Divide the Shivalinga top width by eight, nine, twelve or eleven as desired, omitting portions of two, one, two and three respectively.
TS-P2V126B-lingatop.game: Linga crown detailing options (divisor + omission pairs); figure-finishing selector.

TS-P2V134B-altardrain.claim_en: Leave the central idol-seat part of the altar; divide the remaining width into two to serve as water drains on both sides.
TS-P2V134B-altardrain.game: Altar drainage: center seat + twin side drains feeding the pranala outlet (builder Pranala/NalaStem cite this).

TS-P2V135B-altarpit.claim_en: While shaping the idol, make a pit in the altar double (or one and a half times) the stem size.
TS-P2V135B-altarpit.game: Altar socket sizing (2x/1.5x stem); pitha node param.

TS-P2V136B-fixpit.claim_en: The fixing pit for the idol shall be two angulas, one angula or half an angula (as the case requires).
TS-P2V136B-fixpit.game: Idol fixing-socket options (2|1|0.5 angula); pitha node param.

TS-P2V138B-subsidiary.claim_en: Where the main idol carries full limb detail, make a smaller plain idol without detail beside it; proportions eleven, nine, seven, five or three relative to the main idol (also for temporary shrine/idol purposes).
TS-P2V138B-subsidiary.game: Parivara/utsava figure program (plain subsidiary at graded ratios); parivara_shrines + festival-image nodes cite this.

TS-P2V16B-nishkrama.claim_en: The overlapping (nishkrama/projection) of Jagati beyond the yoni socle equals its own height; Kumuda takes the same projection; Pattika, Kampa, Pati and the rest project three-fourth, half or one-quarter of their respective heights to all sides; Paduka projects measured from the Jagati line.
TS-P2V16B-nishkrama.claim_sa: यावत् स्वोत्सेधमानम् ... तत्तुल्यं ... उच्छ्रयसमम् ... पादोनम् ... अर्धांशकम् ... पादांशकम् ... मानसूत्रात् समन्ताच्चतुर्दिशं बहिर्गमयेत्
TS-P2V16B-nishkrama.game: Builder param: per-moulding outward projection from mana-sutra; jagati=1.0*h, kumuda=same, rest in {0.75,0.5,0.25}*h by sobha (beauty-fit); paduka measured off jagati line.

TS-P2V17B-garbhawall.claim_en: Having raised a fitting adhisthana and levelled its top with stone slabs, divide and construct as appropriate the garbha (sanctum) inner wall, outer wall and the middle nadi (corridor/cavity) between them.
TS-P2V17B-garbhawall.claim_sa: चित्वेत्यधिष्ठानमिहानुरूपं समं तलीकृत्य शिलाप्रतानैः । विभज्य गर्भान्तरबाह्यभित्ति- तन्मध्यनाडी रचयेद् यथार्हम् ।। 17 ।।
TS-P2V17B-garbhawall.game: Spec node: garbha walls as inner+outer bhitti with middle nadi; builder renders double-wall sanctum shell (sandhara-ready) on levelled slab course.

TS-P2V18B-garbha9.claim_en: The width (vitati) of the sanctum is taught in nine modes - dividing the shrine circumference (vyasa) by even/odd schemes with odd shares from three, five, seven up to fifteen and taking shares two to eight in order; or eightfold division with vasu share; or five shares; or half (ardha) of the whole house.
TS-P2V18B-garbha9.claim_sa: गर्भालयस्य विततिर्नवधोदिता । ... त्र्यादिपञ्चदशान्तिमैस्त्रिपञ्चसप्तादिविषमविभागैः ... द्वयाद्यष्टन्तिमैरंशैः ... वसुभागयुते अष्टधा विभक्ते । पञ्चांशकैश्च । अर्धतः ... (Vimarshini + Nibandhana quote in anchor)
TS-P2V18B-garbha9.game: Builder selector: 9 garbha-width methods; slice uses mode 9 (ardha = 1/2 of house). Other 8 kept as validated alternatives with share tables.

TS-P2V19B-walls.claim_en: The outer wall thickness is one-eighth of the shrine perimeter and the inner wall one-eighth of the garbhagriha; a nadi corridor runs all around between the two walls; in a small shrine the two walls may be merged into one solid (ghana) wall.
TS-P2V19B-walls.claim_sa: बाह्या गृहव्यासगजांशतः स्याद् भित्तिः परा गर्भगजांशतश्च । नाडी समन्तादुभयान्तराले संमेल्य वा भित्तियुगं गृहेऽल्पे ।। 19 ।।
TS-P2V19B-walls.game: Spec params: wall thicknesses (perimeter/8, garbha/8) + nadi corridor; small-shrine merged-wall variant flag. Builder renders double shell or solid per flag.

TS-P2V23B-kudyastambha.claim_en: Kudya (wall) pillars of god-houses from three hastas up: one on each of the four corners and two between each pair (twelve total) at equal intervals, beams (uttara) fixed over them; shrines of eleven karas and above take twenty pillars of varied shapes and decoration. Unequal pillar spacing destroys the vastu.
TS-P2V23B-kudyastambha.claim_sa: ... कोणचतुष्कमध्यविनिवेश्याः ... द्वादश स्तम्भाः ... समान्तराः ... एकादशकरादिषु ... विंशतिः ... एषु स्तम्भेषूत्तरमर्पयेत् ... ।। 23 ।।
TS-P2V23B-kudyastambha.game: Builder: square pada gets 12 kudya-stambhas (4 corners + 2 per face, equal spacing) carrying the uttara; 20-pillar variant for >=11-kara shrines (future).

TS-P2V24B-stambhashape.claim_en: Pillars take shapes by plan fitness: all-square, all-octagonal, sixteen-angled, or all-round; or triple-width-based octagons above; or square at the base from the diagonal chord turning round above; or trunk-bifurcation (shunda) round ornament types. Nibandhana/Kashyapa give potika grades (uttama/madhyama/ kanishtha) with kumbha-mandi- Virakanda ornament programs.
TS-P2V24B-stambhashape.game: Pillar-type selector (shape program + potika grade) for mandapa/hall pillars; builder default square timber, variants per grade.

TS-P2V25B-stambhamember.claim_en: Pillar members from the base: oma pedestal two dandas wide and a pada high; ghata pot-member two dandas wide and up to a pada-plus high; mandi top plank four dandas wide; virakanda block above it; potika bracket three, four or five and a half dandas long, half the pillar-base width high (grades uttama/ madhyama/kanishtha per Kashyapa).
TS-P2V25B-stambhamember.game: Pillar assembly params (oma/ghata/mandi/virakanda/potika) in danda units; builder mandapa pillars gain oma bases + potika brackets.

TS-P2V26B-bhittivibhaga.claim_en: Divide the wall width into eleven parts measured from the sanctum center: five inside the doorstep and seven outside; except the main door, the rest shall be solid-rock false doors (ghanadvara) set into door pillars with supports.
TS-P2V26B-bhittivibhaga.game: Wall program: 11-part division from garbha center (5 in / 7 out); ghanadvara false-door nodes on non-main faces.

TS-P2V28B-doorwidth.claim_en: The door width is fixed by dividing the (pillar/wall) height by one of two, seventeen, eleven or seven; then choosing one, eight, five or three divisions to set the width.
TS-P2V28B-doorwidth.game: Builder param: door width selector from height divisors; mukhamandapa door frame sized by rule, not by eye.

TS-P2V29B-doorheight.claim_en: For temples of all gods, divide the pillar height (from the basement) by eight, nine or ten and make one division less to fix the door height.
TS-P2V29B-doorheight.game: Builder param: door height = pillar_height*(d-1)/d for d in {8,9,10}.

TS-P2V30B-doorplank.claim_en: Deduct the door height from the pillar height and divide the remainder by five; two portions give the base cross-plank (uttara) thickness; the top lintel is shaped likewise (divided by nine, equal thickness); above the crossbar to the beam-top fix a panel bearing a goddess figure for auspiciousness.
TS-P2V30B-doorplank.game: Builder params: uttara plank 2/5 remainder, matching lintel, goddess panel above beam (torana clubs with V60 murti program).

TS-P2V33B-sopana.claim_en: A flight of steps (sopana) shall run from the shrine-door base down to the ground.
TS-P2V33B-sopana.game: Access node: sopana steps door-base to ground (granite); already in builder; provenance only.

TS-P2V34B-ghanareplica.claim_en: Divide the main-door width by eight; taking five portions for width and twice (or two and a half) the size, construct door replicas (ghanadvara) on the other three sides of the shrine.
TS-P2V34B-ghanareplica.game: Ghanadvara sizing: width 5/8 main door, height 2-2.5x; builder false-door nodes sized by rule.

TS-P2V36B-ghanabhitti.claim_en: The wall around the shrine (ghanabhitti) shall be built solid from base to beam with hard substances - stone or bricks and the like.
TS-P2V36B-ghanabhitti.game: Material rule: pada walls solid stone/brick base-to-beam (laterite permitted by Kerala custom as hard-stone analogue - note).

TS-P2V37B-vedika.claim_en: The vedika (altar-course above the wall / over adhisthana marking pada start) measures one-eighth, one-seventh or one-sixth of the pillar height.
TS-P2V37B-vedika.game: Builder param: vedika course height from pillar height options; top adhisthana band doubles as vedika datum.

TS-P2V38B-ornament.claim_en: Every prasada carries toranas and four doors; wall ornament grades by size: 5-hasta shrines get 8 panjaras with gavaksha lattices (nandyavarta, gajendra- eyes, creepers, swastikas); 7-hasta adds chitra-makara torana, 12 kudya feet, karna-kutas and eight sala-panjaras; 9-hasta adds karna-kutas with sala-panjara- toranas; 11/13-kara shrines take 20 pillars, 16 nasis above and hara courses.
TS-P2V38B-ornament.game: Ornament-grade selector by shrine size (LOD/detail tiers); slice (12/8h) sits between 9h and 11-kara grades - current hara+kuta/sala/ panjara + 12 kudya + torana-less doors recorded as mid-grade shorthand.

TS-P2V41B-jalaka.claim_en: Dormer windows (nasi), then windows (jalaka) above the vedi altar, two to four dandas wide.
TS-P2V41B-jalaka.game: Wall-opening params: jalaka widths above vedi; builder wall articulation (future boolean cutouts).

TS-P2V44B-khandottara.claim_en: Wall plates (uttara) are threefold: Khandottara best (width and height equal to pillar width), Patrottara middling (thickness three-fourth, i.e. a pada less), Rupottara lowest (half thickness); chulika fixing follows with Ghana-tati inversion option.
TS-P2V44B-khandottara.game: Beam profile selector: khandottara (square section) default for uttara members.

TS-P2V48B-rafters.claim_en: Over the fillet on the beams, fit rafters (kazhukol) with their tips joined at the top of the pyramidal roof; at the rafter tips fix the ridge fillet, one-eighth, one-seventh or one-sixth of the wall plate in width.
TS-P2V48B-rafters.game: Roof-timber program: beam fillet -> rafters to apex -> ridge fillet sized 1/8|1/7|1/6 of plate; builder solid pyramid stands in for the rafter assembly (recorded approximation).

TS-P2V50B-finial.claim_en: Above (the roof) fix two or three finials with pot-like belly and lotus-bud tip; clad the shrine roof well with copper sheets (or hard bricks) proof against rain and sun-heat.
TS-P2V50B-finial.game: Finial count/form + copper cladding spec; builder copper kalasha + timber roof already carry this; stupi count 1 noted as slice shorthand vs 2-3 allowed.

TS-P2V52B-alpa8.claim_en: In a small (alpa) temple, double the width-derived height and divide by eight: the lowest share forms the masuraka/adhisthana socle, two shares the stambha (pillar/wall), one share the prastara, one share the gala recess, two shares the shikhara roof and one share the stupika finial (1+2+1+1+2+1).
TS-P2V52B-alpa8.claim_sa: ... विस्तृतिद्विगुणितप्रायोच्छ्रये ... अष्टशिते सति । मूलांशेन ... मसूरकोच्छ्रयम् ... व्यंशतः स्तम्भोच्छ्रयम्, भूयोंऽशतः प्रस्तरम् ... एकांशेन ... गल ... भागाभ्यां शिखरोच्छ्रयम्, एकांशतः स्तूपिकाम् ... ।। 52 ।।
TS-P2V52B-alpa8.game: Validated alternative elevation scheme for alpa plans; builder gains an alpa-mode switch (future). Slice keeps 1:2:1 halves (INTERPRETATION).

TS-P2V54B-ekatala.claim_en: Thus narrated are the rules for small single-storey (ekatala) temples of square plan; single-storey shrines range three to ten hastas in width.
TS-P2V54B-ekatala.game: Scope gate: ekatala-square plans validate width in 3-10h; circular analogue recorded, not enforced.

TS-P2V56B-talantara.claim_en: In multi-storey building: raise the inner (arudha) wall fittingly, fix a ridge beam over it, attach rafters with marked fillets, lay a ridge plank to level it, then set the gala recess over the (levelled) wall top.
TS-P2V56B-talantara.game: Tala-transition assembly (antar-wall -> ridge -> rafters -> plank -> gala); builder hara+tala2 massing stands in for the assembly (recorded approximation).

TS-P2V57B-griva9.claim_en: Divide the first-storey pillar height (base to wall plate) into nine and take shares three through eleven in order; the gala (griva recess) height is fixed in nine types by two, three, three, three, five, seven, five, eight and nine divisions respectively; the same measure applies floor by floor, with a proper prastara entablature on every tala.
TS-P2V57B-griva9.claim_sa: स्तम्भ ... त्र्याद्येकादशान्तैरंशरांशिते ... द्वित्रित्रित्रिपञ्चसप्तपञ्चाष्टनवभिरंशैः ... नवधा ग्रीवोक्ता ... प्रतितलं ... प्रस्तरप्रक्रिया ... ।। 57 ।।
TS-P2V57B-griva9.game: Builder selector: 9 gala/griva heights from pillar shares; prastara emitted per tala (already in builder massing). Slice default: mid type (share 7 -> gala 5/9 pillar) pending tala-height pinning.

TS-P2V60B-tala2.claim_en: On the second storey place kutas at the corners (vidisha) and salas in the cardinal directions, with pairs of nasi dormers between sala and kuta; on the four sides set Brahma in the east, Dakshinamurti in the south, Narasimha in the west and Krishna (or Skanda) in the north, in wood or stone; great nasis crown the conical roof above.
TS-P2V60B-tala2.claim_sa: तले द्वितीये ... विदिशासु कूटान्, दिशासु शालाश्च ... द्विशो नासीः ... दिशासु ... ब्रह्माद्या मूर्तयः ... तदूर्ध्वगतशिखरे महानासीः ... ।। 60 ।।
TS-P2V60B-tala2.game: Builder: tala2 corner kutas + cardinal salas + nasi pairs + 4 directional murti figures (E/S/W/N) + roof mahanasis.

TS-P2V61B-upper-tala.claim_en: Above the gala (as in a third storey too) the upper-storey wall is thinner than the first-storey wall; set wall plate and beam, fix rafters uniting with the lower rafter tips, the upper rafters overlapping half the pillar height; upper pillars stand on the lower beams (tula).
TS-P2V61B-upper-tala.game: Upper-tala junction assembly (thinner wall + plate/beam + united rafters at half-pillar overlap); builder 0.72 narrowing + stacked massing stands in for the assembly.

TS-P2V62B-jati.claim_en: Temples of three to twelve storeys are Jati (mahaprasada): measured in eleven (odd) and twelve (even) hastas rising to seventy; each of vahni-tala upward takes six forms (odd/even x low/mid/high); height exceeds width by three- sevenths (e.g. 70-hasta width -> 100-hasta height); per-tala decrement two karas for madhyama, again two for kanishtha.
TS-P2V62B-jati.game: Scope table for Jati multi-tala generation (3-12 storeys, 11/12h measures to 70h, per-tala 2-kara decrement, height +3/7 rule).

TS-P2V66B-oblong.claim_en: For an oblong (long-square) temple: halve the desired circumference, divide a half by ten; with four such shares fix the width and with six the length.
TS-P2V66B-oblong.game: Builder plan branch (future): oblong massing from half-paridhi/10 module (4 wide x 6 long).

TS-P2V67B-gajaprishtha.claim_en: For a Gajaprishtha (elephant-back: square + semicircle apse) temple: divide the desired circumference by sixty-four, drop one share; divide the rest by eighteen; with four shares each shape the two sides and the front width; then with a two-share compass line from the side-ends draw the semicircle apse (about six shares in circuit).
TS-P2V67B-gajaprishtha.claim_sa: ... चतुष्षष्टिभागं त्यक्त्वा ... अष्टादशधा ... चतुर्भिरंशैः पार्श्वद्वन्द्व ... मुखविस्तारं ... द्वयंशसूत्रभ्रमात् ... अर्धवृत्तम् ... ।। 67 ।।
TS-P2V67B-gajaprishtha.game: Builder plan branch (future): apsidal massing (square mandala + semicircle apse) from 64-drop-1/18 procedure.

TS-P2V69B-shatkona.claim_en: Divide the desired shrine circumference into six, elongate each share to form a hexagonal temple; its paridhi measure: take two of the six parts, multiply by fifteen and drop two.
TS-P2V69B-shatkona.game: Builder plan branch (future): hexagonal massing from paridhi formula; danda = doubled share per Vimarshini.

TS-P2V70B-ashtashra.claim_en: For an eight-cornered (octagonal) shrine: divide the desired circumference into ten, take three shares as the vyasa/danda; divide that vyasa into twelve and shape the sides with arrow-shares (five-share units).

source.commentary: Vimarshini in verse-anchored passage (truncated; full text retained in corpus)

TS-P2V70B-ashtashra.game: Builder plan branch (future): octagonal massing from paridhi/10*3 vyasa formula.

TS-P2V72B-mukhavistara.claim_en: The Mukhamandapa (front pavilion) width is fixed by dividing the central shrine's circumference by one of two, five, seven, ten or twelve.
TS-P2V72B-mukhavistara.game: Mandapa sizing: mukhamandapa width from central paridhi divisor options; builder porch widths selectable by option.

TS-P2V73B-prakara.claim_en: Accepted prakara (enclosure) measures outward from the prasada: half, one and a half, two, four and seven dandas.
TS-P2V73B-prakara.game: Enclosure rings at danda offsets (unit OPEN); builder ring radii currently conventional (uh+6/+10/+18) - reconcile on danda curation.

TS-P2V74B-uttaraoffset.claim_en: From the circumference of the Uttara wall plate, offsets measure one, one and one-fourth, one and a half, and three-fourth dandas.
TS-P2V74B-uttaraoffset.game: Beam-adjacent offsets in dandas (unit OPEN); recorded for the danda-curation pass.

TS-P2V75B-antarmandala.claim_en: In the antarmandala - the innermost boundary region holding the altar (bali) stones for offerings - its limit shall be fixed properly.
TS-P2V75B-antarmandala.game: Zone definition: antarmandala ring holds bali stones; already in both specs as akatte_balivattam - provenance extended.

TS-P2V76B-mandapapillars.claim_en: A mandapa (hall) takes four pillars with one beam, or sixteen pillars with two beams joining them.
TS-P2V76B-mandapapillars.game: Hall program selector (4+1 | 16+2); 16-pillar variant queued for koothambalam-scale halls.

TS-P2V78B-antahara.claim_en: The Antahara (second boundary; Chuttambalam/Nalambalam in the vernacular, second prakara of the panchaprakara system) holds a square mandapa set by its yoni, joined as a covered corridor enclosing the shrine at one danda from the shrine room.
TS-P2V78B-antahara.game: Ring-2 definition (covered corridor + yoni-set square mandapa at 1 danda); nalambalam nodes in both specs cite this.

TS-P2V79B-sabha.claim_en: In front (toward the entrance) build the sabha assembly hall - a gopura-like member - on the antahara line extended to the entrance length: set the vamsa beam on the side-hara-supported ends, yoni-endowed per its quarter, divide length in five and take one share for width; lay three matching uttaras and the arudha-uttara courses likewise.
TS-P2V79B-sabha.game: Forecourt program: sabha hall toward entrance on extended antahara line (5:1 length:width, yoni-set); gopura/agrasabha nodes cite this.

TS-P2V80B-padasutra.claim_en: For the Padasutra sabha grid: halve the desired circumference and halve the beam measure there; divide by even numbers (four, six, eight ...) to fix the front-hall breadth and length; extend beam lengths suitably on all four sides.
TS-P2V80B-padasutra.game: Sabha grid procedure (halve paridhi+beam, even divisions); front-hall layout calculator input.

TS-P2V82B-pithaheight.claim_en: The bali-pitha (altar stone) height equals the idol seat height, or that less by one-sixth, or equals the sanctum floor level.
TS-P2V82B-pithaheight.game: Bali-pitha height selector (3 options); builder ValiaBalikkal height set to idol-seat option (recorded choice).

TS-P2V83B-pithaseg.claim_en: Conceive the altar stone (pitha) in twenty-seven segments (or thirty-two), with measures arranged per segment program.
TS-P2V83B-pithaseg.game: Pitha segmentation options (27|32); altar builder params.

TS-P2V86B-metrology.claim_en: Best idols divide length by ten (dash tala), middle by nine (nava tala), lowest by eight (ashta tala; Devis ashtatala); one tala divided by twelve is the angula; two angulas a kala (with golaka); one-eighth angula is the yava. Best in stone, middle in wood, lowest in gem (or as desired).
TS-P2V86B-metrology.game: Unit system: tala/angula/yava/kala/golaka with grade table; ALL measure params now convertible (update C-METROLOGY to resolved).

TS-P2V87B-bimbashila.claim_en: Having dressed a square stone and set it firmly on a flat surface, mark upon it the measurements of the desired idol.
TS-P2V87B-bimbashila.game: Workshop step: stone dressing + measure marking precedes idol carving (craft quest chain hook).

TS-P2V89B-sutralines.claim_en: Measurement lines (sutra) shall then be drawn with powder/colour-anointed threads, lengthwise and breadthwise in specified measures, to mark the borders (of shrine, walls and courts).
TS-P2V89B-sutralines.game: Site-layout procedure: thread-grid marking step precedes foundation (shilanyasa quest chain hook).

TS-P2V94B-bimbaface.claim_en: On the idol's face: eight angulas from ear to chin (part of the tala-based facial proportion program).
TS-P2V94B-bimbaface.game: Murti-face proportion datum (8-angula ear-chin); future deity-figure generator input.

TS-P2V95B-bimbalimb.claim_en: Idol limbs (tala series V95-97): navel sixteen angulas long, hips eighteen apart; arm-bases eight angulas apart, elbows six wide; palm eight long by six wide, same measure for the middle finger.
TS-P2V95B-bimbalimb.game: Murti-limb proportion table (angula units); future deity-figure generator input with V94B face + V111 Durga tala.

TS-P2V98B-bimbadigit.claim_en: Digits (series V98-100): thumbs twelve yavas wide, other fingers eight yavas each; index and ring sections one-eighth less than the middle finger, ring and little widths one-fourth less; nails half the top finger-section size.
TS-P2V98B-bimbadigit.game: Murti-digit proportion table (yava units; yava = angula/8 per TS-P2V86B-metrology); deity-figure generator input.

TS-P3V02B-palika16.claim_en: On a swastika diagram of sixteen compartments strewn with paddy and kusha, set sixteen palika pots - sprinkled with astra-purified water, bound with triple thread under kavacha-mantra, adorned with durva and twigs, filled layer upon layer with mud, sand, manure and charcoal - beginning from the agni (southeast) corner in serpentine order.
TS-P3V02B-palika16.game: Inventory + layout: 16 palika pots with layered fills and adornments placed serpentine from Agni corner; ankurarpana scheduler step.

TS-P3V03B-bija.claim_en: After drawing a swastika with powders and chanting the deity-specific Astramantra, the milk-washed seeds kept in a jar are placed into the sanctified (palika) pots.
TS-P3V03B-bija.game: Scheduler step (ankurarpana): swastika -> astra -> milk-wash -> jar -> pots; consumes powders + milk + seeds inventory.

TS-P3V06B-sowing.claim_en: Sow the worshipped seeds with concentrated, purified hands amid sounding instruments and the stated mantra (Durga twelve seeds, other deities ten each); sprinkle holy water cupped in palms oozing between fingers.
TS-P3V06B-sowing.game: Sowing rite (manner + deity counts + sprinkling); extends bija_sow scheduler step with counts.

TS-P3V14B-seedworship.claim_en: The sown seeds are worshipped for twelve days (or for as many nights as the rite runs); Gayatri of each deity accompanies (Subrahmanya and the rest).
TS-P3V14B-seedworship.game: Ankurarpana duration (12 days / rite nights); scheduler calendar span for the seed program.

TS-P3V25B-sandhya.claim_en: Worship ritually at all three day-junctures (morning, noon, evening sandhya) with poured oblations; the preceptor performs the day's oblation early in the morning of the fixed day.
TS-P3V25B-sandhya.game: Daily triple-juncture cadence under the 5-slot nitya program (usha/pantheeradi/ucha/deepa/athazha map onto junctures).

TS-P3V26B-idolreceipt.claim_en: The preceptor shall receive the (finished) idol from the sculptor four days before the fixed installation day.
TS-P3V26B-idolreceipt.game: Calendar anchor (T-4 idol receipt); pratishtha countdown scheduler hook.

TS-P3V28B-netronmilana.claim_en: He shall rub (open) the eyes with the tip of a golden needle dipped in a ghee-honey mixture, forming the eyeballs (netronmilana, eye-opening).
TS-P3V28B-netronmilana.game: Eye-opening rite (gold needle + ghee-honey); consecration cutscene beat; consumes ghee+honey.

TS-P3V29B-parivara.claim_en: Adore the surrounding (parivara) deities starting from the east through all eight regions in order.
TS-P3V29B-parivara.game: Parivara adoration order (E -> 8 regions); sribali circuit direction data.

TS-P3V31B-stool.claim_en: The preceptor shall engage the sculptor - presented with fitting gifts and thereby pleased - to set the idol upon a wooden stool in the posture of its consecration.
TS-P3V31B-stool.game: Workshop handover (gift -> stool placement); craft quest content with V48B temple receipt.

TS-P3V32B-sambhara.claim_en: Assemble: butea fronds, bamboo, anthill earth, fertile land, ox horn, sands from both riverbanks, and plenty of water.
TS-P3V32B-sambhara.game: Rite-material checklist (sambhara); inventory fetch-list extension candidate (units TBD).

TS-P3V38B-kautuka.claim_en: Standing with darbha-grass anjali, pray with the two mantras, take the kautuka - white wool thread binding kshauma cloth holding pearl, mustard and gold - wind it seven times with thumb and ring fingers while murmuring its own anu-mantra, and tie the mighty, auspicious, all-protecting bracelet on the idol's right (principal) arm at the mantra's end, after its astra-sprinkling, drying, worship and charming.
TS-P3V38B-kautuka.game: Kautuka rite (prep -> wind x7 -> tie right arm); protective bracelet buff item on idol; adhivasa program content.

TS-P3V44B-ratha.claim_en: Bind the idol with a darbha-grass rope and carry it in a chariot procession with parasol, flag and festoons, lamps and musical instruments.
TS-P3V44B-ratha.game: Procession program (binding + chariot + accompaniments); utsava/seeveli content; cart_boat traffic pattern precedent in kalari.

TS-P3V46B-jaladhivasa.claim_en: Plunge (lay) the idol in water, head to the east, resting on the bank upon a fig-wood plank, contemplating it as a shining divinity (jaladhivasa, water-adhivasa).
TS-P3V46B-jaladhivasa.game: Jaladhivasa program step (water immersion, head-east); kulam/tank node cite this.

TS-P3V48B-receive.claim_en: Purified by bath and purificatory acts, the preceptor shall ceremonially receive the (finished) temple from the carpenter's hands in the evening.
TS-P3V48B-receive.game: Handover beat (carpenter -> preceptor, evening); construction plot phase completion hook (mirrors temple_plot dwaja/abhisheka beats).

TS-P3V52B-prokshana.claim_en: Sprinkle with waters, gather the raksha (protective) group here, and drive out the settled (adverse) ones.
TS-P3V52B-prokshana.game: Purification sweep (sprinkle -> gather protection -> expel); shuddhi program content.

TS-P3V53B-gomaya.claim_en: First touch the sanctum, brush the interior and the inter-wall passages, splashing cowdung-mixed water.
TS-P3V53B-gomaya.game: Sanctum-shuddhi step (touch + brush + gomaya splash); purification program content.

TS-P3V60B-homadravya.claim_en: With other (deity-specific) mantras pour ghee to all deities; sanctify with mantra the apamarga-ash-and-water offering; cleanse and worship with mantras the two pots on the altar.
TS-P3V60B-homadravya.game: Homa offering set (ghee + ash-water + 2 pots); homa-prelude inventory content.

TS-P3V63B-westpot.claim_en: In the pot on the western side put gold pieces and rice till full, worshipping with the prescribed mantra invocation.
TS-P3V63B-westpot.game: West-pot vessel (gold + rice, full); homa inventory content.

TS-P3V65B-homaprogram.claim_en: Propitiate all deities with 'Shanno devi' before offering into fire: shami sticks, ghee, panchagavya and durva, one hundred eight times, with a purnahuti closing each group; Durga, Vishnu, Shasta and Subrahmanya take variant mantras and materials (Durga: Jatavedase opening tetrad).
TS-P3V65B-homaprogram.game: Homa program (108x + purnahuti/group + deity variants); homa-prelude scheduler content; fire FX + count tracker.

TS-P3V66B-balimantra.claim_en: Scatter darbha-grass tips and offer bali with mantras beginning 'Namo Rudra' (before the fire); deity materials follow with their stated mantras at stated times, then wave lights (nirajana) presenting platefuls.
TS-P3V66B-balimantra.game: Bali+nirajana program (darbha -> mantra bali -> plateful lights); bali-stone interaction content.

TS-P3V73B-vishnuhoma.claim_en: For Vishnu: in nine columns starting from the northeast, place the twelve twigs/substances.
TS-P3V73B-vishnuhoma.game: Vishnu homa layout (9 NE columns x 12 substances); homa-ground arrangement data.

TS-P3V76B-potsubstance.claim_en: Beginning from the east, fill the (kalasha) pots with pearls, decoction, cow urine, cowdung-mixed water, milk and ghee, fruits and medicinal water.
TS-P3V76B-potsubstance.game: Kalasha-pot fill table (E→ substances); snapana/kalasha inventory content.

TS-P3V78B-shivapot.claim_en: For Shiva fill the pots from the east onward with mantra chanting (same substance order as V76B).
TS-P3V78B-shivapot.game: Shiva kalasha-pot fills (E-> + mantra); snapana inventory content for the Shiva slice.

TS-P4V01-mandapashuddhi.claim_en: The (adhivasa) pavilion shall be cleared by sweeping and decorated with garlands and festoons in an act of purification.
TS-P4V01-mandapashuddhi.game: Scheduler step: mandapa-shuddhi precedes adhivasa rites; requires garland/festoon inventory.

TS-P4V101B-upachara.claim_en: Having meditated on, invoked and embodied (sakalikritya) the god: offer padya and achamana; apply gandha with Aghora, cloth with Vamadeva, flowers with Ishana, dhupa with Tatpurusha and deepa; prostrate; then with ashtagandha on both palms touch the linga part by part - square Brahma part with Brahma-gayatri, octagonal Vishnu part with Vishnu-gayatri, circular Rudra part with Rudra-gayatri.
TS-P4V101B-upachara.game: Scheduler upachara program (11 steps) with mantra-tagged offerings; linga-touch sub-rite gated on tripartite parts.

TS-P4V102B-punyaha.claim_en: With gayatri mantras worship with white flowers and garlands, wave lights (nirajana), and chant the Punyaha with the murtipas (image-bearers).
TS-P4V102B-punyaha.game: Punyaha program (gayatri -> white flowers -> nirajana -> chant with murtipas); purification rite content.

TS-P4V103B-upaharagifts.claim_en: Worshipping again with rites, present him footwear, vehicle, umbrella and mirror; with sandal, flowers, incense, light, ornaments, fans and umbrella among the upacharas.
TS-P4V103B-upaharagifts.game: Gift-upachara program (present + fan/umbrella/mirror); extends V101B hospitality sequence.

TS-P4V104B-durgamantra.claim_en: For Durga employ her five connected mantras (in the upachara round).
TS-P4V104B-durgamantra.game: Durga upachara mantra set (5); deity-keyed mantra selector with V113B shayya set.

TS-P4V105B-durgaabhi.claim_en: After punyaha-sprinkling with the five Durga anu-mantras, clothe (the Durga image) in a red silk pair; offer deepa, alankara, vitana, chamara-pair and chatra; wave lights (nirajana) in the quarters from east to zenith with 'ayam puro harikesha' and the rest; then hymn her with own-agama mantras.
TS-P4V105B-durgaabhi.game: Durga abhisheka program (punyaha -> red silk -> offerings -> dik-nirajana -> stuti); festival-rite content.

TS-P4V106B-subrahmanya.claim_en: For Subrahmanya pour abhisheka from nine kalashas in order - kusha-water through gandha-water - with nine mantras (astra, kavaca, mula, hridaya; Agnimile, Ishe-tva, Shanno-devi pratikas).
TS-P4V106B-subrahmanya.game: Subrahmanya abhisheka (9 kalashas + 9 mantras); abhisheka scheduler content.

TS-P4V107B-skandasnapana.claim_en: Bathe (Skanda) with his own Gayatri pouring much water; drape a cloth pair (yuvam vastra mantra); present in order gold upavita, gandha, flowers, dhupa, deepa, chamara(-pair), umbrella, collyrium, mirror and footwear pair with mantras; wave lights and do Punyaha with 'skandah priyatam'.
TS-P4V107B-skandasnapana.game: Skanda snapana-upachara program (bath -> cloth -> 10 upacharas -> nirajana -> punyaha); abhisheka content.

TS-P4V108B-ganapatishuddhi.claim_en: For Ganapati's purification employ his eight connected mantras.
TS-P4V108B-ganapatishuddhi.game: Ganapati shuddhi mantra set (8); deity-keyed mantra selector.

TS-P4V109B-bimbashuddhi.claim_en: Thus stated is the purification of all images (akhila-bimbashuddhi): for Vighna five upaharas with water, then nirajana and punyaha likewise.
TS-P4V109B-bimbashuddhi.game: All-image purification program (5 upaharas + water -> nirajana -> punyaha); parivara-shuddhi content.

TS-P4V110B-vahana.claim_en: Having given all deities their arghya, lift the idols into the vehicle with the prescribed mantra chant (procession ascent).
TS-P4V110B-vahana.game: Procession ascent (arghya -> lift -> vehicle); seeveli/ utsava program content with V44B.

TS-P4V111B-rathamantra.claim_en: At the chariot ascent of all deities alike use the anu-mantra 'rathe tishthan' (standing in the chariot); for Shangi (Vishnu) and Hari add purusha-japa.
TS-P4V111B-rathamantra.game: Chariot-ascent utterance (universal + Vishnu purusha-japa); procession audio hook.

TS-P4V112B-dvararghya.claim_en: At the sanctum door give arghya to all gods with their own mantras.
TS-P4V112B-dvararghya.game: Sanctum-door arghya program (per-deity mantras); bell/door interaction content.

TS-P4V113B-shayyamantra.claim_en: In laying the idol on the couch (shayya): Shiva with Vamadeva; Sankaranarayana with Namo Hiranyagarbha; Durga with Jatavedase plus Pranava; all others with their Mulamantra; Vishnu (Indir-esha) with the twelve-syllabled hymn.

source.commentary: Vimarshini in verse-anchored passage (Vivarana truncated in anchor)

TS-P4V113B-shayyamantra.game: Shayya step mantra selector keyed by deity; feeds role-based rite performance (Tantri selects mantra set).

TS-P4V114B-shayana.claim_en: Having pervaded the three abodes (and others) each with its own mula-mantra and embodied (sakalikritya) the image with mantras, lay it to sleep (shayana) facing the temple (prasada-sammukham) as here taught.
TS-P4V114B-shayana.game: Shayana step: embodied image laid facing prasada; completes the shayya-adhivasa arc (V113 mantras -> V114 laying).

TS-P4V115B-shayanahead.claim_en: For the shayana laying (here in the Skanda rite): set a pitha by the couch for arghya/seat worship before manasa-puja; lay the image head-north when the door faces east, head-south when the door faces west.
TS-P4V115B-shayanahead.game: Shayana orientation parameter (door facing -> head direction); Skanda-rite values stored; Vishnu values OPEN.

TS-P4V26B-dvarapala.claim_en: For Sankaranarayana the eight door-guardians are Shiva-Vishnu fusions - Mahodara-Purnatman, Mahakaya-Pushkaratman, Mahakantha-Anantatman and five more - invoked with combined mantras.
TS-P4V26B-dvarapala.game: NPC program: 8 fused dvarapala stations at sanctum doors; invoked in combined-mantra order for Sankaranarayana complexes.

TS-P4V39B-agni.claim_en: The priest, purified and having worshipped Vighnesa, sprinkles the sacrificial fire with holy water chanting the mystic formula, then draws dividing lines on the kindled, blazing fire.
TS-P4V39B-agni.game: Scheduler step (pre-adhivasa): agni-kindling rite with Vighnesa precondition; fire prop state kindled->blazing.

TS-P4V52-shayya.claim_en: The preceptor shall prepare, to the right side of the pavilion, a spot levelled with water and mud, and build there a bed chamber (shayya) facing the sanctum.
TS-P4V52-shayya.game: Scheduler step: shayya construction ( Sayana-adhivasa ); spatial constraint: right-of-mandapa, facing garbha.

TS-P4V64-deepa.claim_en: Many lamps shall lighten up the interior of the (adhivasa) hall.
TS-P4V64-deepa.game: Scheduler/lighting step: deepa array lit for adhivasa; lamp inventory + omni-budget check (scene owns lights).

TS-P4V66B-subrahmanya8.claim_en: For Subrahmanya keep ready eight items: potful of water, flagstaff, diamond, svastika, javelin, chamara pair, elephant replica and peacock replica.
TS-P4V66B-subrahmanya8.game: Deity prop set (8 items); festival-prop inventory content for Subrahmanya rites.

TS-P4V67B-ashtamangala.claim_en: For Ganapati and Shasta apply the eight auspicious items (ashtamangala) as for Shiva (or Vishnu): mirror, full water pot, ox, chamara pair, shrivatsa, svastika, conch and lamp (bhauma-deepa).
TS-P4V67B-ashtamangala.game: Ashtamangala prop set (8 items, deity-shared with Shiva/ Vishnu variants); festival-prop inventory content.

TS-P4V76-ghrita.claim_en: In a golden goblet, ghee and honey sanctified with mantra shall be arranged.
TS-P4V76-ghrita.game: Inventory: golden goblet + ghee + honey, mantra-consecrated; consumed at snapana/abhisheka steps.

TS-P4V88B-pushpa.claim_en: Again giving oblation with materials and water, the priest shall meditate upon the god and then shower flowers (pushpa).
TS-P4V88B-pushpa.game: Scheduler step: oblation -> dhyana -> pushpa shower; consumes flowers + water inventory.
